visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied in a bun, wearing a navy blue sweatshirt with large white heart patterns, stands in a kitchen holding a baby. The baby wears a light-colored bib and has a blue pacifier. They are looking at a cardboard box on a white countertop cluttered with household items and baby supplies. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting on a white foam play mat in a living room. She holds a blue tray filled with white mahjong-style tiles that have English letters on them. She smiles broadly at the camera. In the background, a grey sofa and toy storage are visible. (3) A man in a black t-shirt and glasses sits on the floor opposite the woman, arranging the letter tiles into words. Close-up shots show the white tiles spelling out words like "net", "Jeff", "ego", and "jin". The woman uses a smartphone to verify the words. (4) The woman holds her phone screen toward the camera, showing a dictionary definition and later a Google search result for a celebrity. She laughs uncontrollably, covering her face and leaning forward on the mat. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the indoor home setting.
